answers.core: This change improves the experience of C# integration in Godot for more technical users.
answers.workaround: The current overload works, but is not optimal in more allocation heavy conditions. Limiting strain on the C# Garbage Collector is always nice when there's a lot going on. The current overload limits how much developers can do to optimize memory allocation in the .Net CLR.

title: Add a version of C# `GD.VarToBytes()` that uses Span instead of an array
